text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Trainer!
Truly, thou hast done well to suggest taking a break!
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I binge-watched a historical drama!
It was an ensemble piece set in the Warring States period, and the tactical mind games between the warlords were fiercely riveting...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, indeed!!
Wilt thou watch it with me next time!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And then we shall discuss our thoughts on the drama
all night long over some cola!!
Nyahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason is looking full of energy.
It seems she had a very fulfilling break.
